subtitle: Seven days on Bene't Street. The queue never ends. Neither do the overheads.
intro: Set a price, buy tubs, pick up to 3 flavours, then open the stand. Tap or Space during the day to speed up

events.name: Tourist coachloads
events.blurb: Three coaches from Heathrow have parked on Trumpington Street. They want gelato and a photo of King's.

events.name: Exam term
events.blurb: Students are sad. Sad students buy gelato, but only cheap gelato.

events.name: May Week (in June)
events.blurb: Everyone is hungover and rich in spirit only.

events.name: Bin day
events.blurb: Bene't Street smells of bins. Nobody can say why this matters, but it does.

events.name: Punt tout convention
events.blurb: Two hundred punt touts on their break. They will haggle.

reports: A tourist photographed the queue and left without buying.
A supervisor asked for an extension on their cone.
The Eagle across the road would like its customers back.
Someone asked if the queue counts as a college society.
Corpus Christi complained about the noise. The Corpus Clock ate a minute in protest.
A goose attempted to pay in bread.
The Bursar walked past and made a note.
facts: The real SBR is the graduate common room in I2, First Court. No queue, and a pool table.
Port & Sherry is served in the SBR after hall on Fridays, GBP1.50 a glass.
BA Table is every Tuesday and Friday in term: one of the three hall tables is reserved for graduates.
The Graduate Study Room (GSR) is at 1 All Saints Passage.
The SBR was founded in 1960. The room was named after Samuel Butler in 1958, a century after his graduation.
The SBR room has a TV with a Wii, board games, a piano and a small kitchen. Bring your own gelato.

end.week: Week over. The stand is yours forever, or until the lease review.
end.bankrupt: The Bursar has repossessed your stand. It will be a punt tout booth by Tuesday.
